chapter: Opinions on singers, promotion and originality
title: Today's singers versus the great band vocalists
summary: Edison criticises current pop singers like Helen Reddy while praising Sarah Vaughan, Ella Fitzgerald and others who came out of the bands.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: The singer was like an accompaniment to a band. Now you're an accompaniment to singers. It's a singer's era. This is the singer's era, right now. And I wouldn't say -- call all of them singers. This is just the screamers era. You know, because those who are making money now, to me, they're not good singers. They're not good singers. You can name them all -- you can count them all on both hands, the good ones coming up nowadays, you know. I think Streisand can sing. She's a newcomer. Just put Sarah Vaughn and Ella Fitzgerald and the good singers on the side. We know that they have quality. Frank Sinatra, Billy Eckstine, Carman McRae, you know. The good singers, Peggy Lee, all of the ones that sang with the old bands,
